description: Tomás Korenblit, Bayesian Data Scientist. Notes on books, ideas, and what I'm working on.
homeBio:
I'm a data scientist interested in causal inference, AI safety, and the history and philosophy of science. Right now I'm focused on AI safety. Lately that's meant trying to measure how well LLMs actually follow instructions: I have a paper on it accepted at JAIIO 2026, and I just finished BlueDot's Technical AI Safety course.

Feel free to send an email if you want to talk.
